'''Melody's Hair''' is an {{Epic}} [[Accessory]] obtainable through {{NPCSprite|Melody}}'s quest-line in [[The Park]].

== Obtaining ==
Upon completing the main Harp songs (up to La Vie en Rose – excluding the {{Item|Personal Harp}} exclusive songs, '''Through the Campfire''' and '''Pachelbel''') with at least a 90% score, {{NPCSprite|Melody}} will reward you with this accessory.

== Usage ==
The accessory grants +6 {{Stat|int}}.

Left-click the [[Accessory]] to tune-up and right-click to play the note you tuned.

'''Melody's Hair''' has a range of 24 notes, over 2 octaves. From lowest to highest on the scale (Chromatic Scale), the following are the notes you can play:

'''F#''', '''G''', '''G#''', '''A''', '''A#''', '''B''', '''C''', '''C#''', '''D''', '''D#''', '''E''', '''F''', '''F#''', '''G''', '''G#''', '''A''', '''A#''', '''B''', '''C''', '''C#''', '''D''', '''D#''', '''E''', '''F'''

== Trivia ==
*If you complete La Vie en Rose through the {{Item|Personal Harp}}, you still have to go talk to {{NPCSprite|Melody}} in the {{zone|Savanna Woodland}} to claim '''Melody's Hair'''.
*Previously you could trade with another player to get this [[Accessories|accessory]], the person receiving the item will '''not''' be able to use it if they have not already completed the final song (La Vie en Rose) and earned their own. None of the properties of the item will work either (the {{Stat|Int}} boost, item ability, or [[Accessory Power]] obtained from the item).
**Sometimes it is bugged and says "Requires Melody's Hair completion" even if you have completed La Vie en Rose. Switching to a different lobby usually resolves this.
*[[Experience Artifact]], [[Personal Compactor]], [[Personal Deletor]], [[Book of Progression]], '''Melody's Hair''', [[Zombie Talisman]], [[Skeleton Talisman]], [[Archaeologist's Compass]], [[Lucky Hoof]], [[Eternal Hoof]], [[Shiny Yellow Rock]] and [[Yellow Rock of Love]] are the only accessories to use a vanilla sprite, rather than a custom made one.
